RidgeCV.description: Ridge, alpha chosen by chronological validation

LassoCV.description: Lasso, alpha chosen by chronological validation

MLP-rank-256-128-64.description: MLP 256-128-64, dropout 0.3, within-month rank target, 5-seed average

MLP-huber-128-64.description: MLP 128-64, Huber loss on clipped return, 5-seed average

OLS-rank.description: OLS on the within-month rank target

HGB-return.description: Histogram gradient boosting on next month's return

HGB-rank.description: Histogram gradient boosting on the within-month rank target

HGB-quintile.description: Histogram gradient boosting classifier on the return quintile, sorted on expected quintile

OLS.What it is: Plain linear regression, the baseline for everything else.

OLS-rank.Predicts: Next month's rank within the month
OLS-rank.What it is: OLS with the rank target. Comparing it to OLS shows what the target does on its own, without a more flexible model.

Ridge.What it is: Linear regression with a small fixed penalty on coefficients. An untuned baseline.

RidgeCV.What it is: Linear regression that shrinks all coefficients toward zero.

Lasso.What it is: Linear regression that sets coefficients to exactly zero. An untuned baseline. This penalty is so strong that it keeps a single predictor every year (IndRetBig, an industry return), which creates many tied predictions.

LassoCV.What it is: Linear regression that sets coefficients to exactly zero, so it also picks variables. It typically keeps about 10 of the 200+ predictors.

MLP-rank-256-128-64.Predicts: Next month's rank within the month
MLP-rank-256-128-64.What it is: Three hidden layers (256, 128, 64) with dropout of 0.3, averaged over 5 networks. This is the neural net in the Full Code Example.

MLP-rank-128-64.Predicts: Next month's rank within the month
MLP-rank-128-64.What it is: Smaller network with two hidden layers (128, 64), averaged over 5 networks.

MLP-huber-128-64.What it is: Two hidden layers (128, 64), averaged over 5 networks. Its Huber loss reduces the influence of outliers.

HGB-return.Tuning: Number of trees chosen each year
HGB-return.What it is: Up to 300 small trees grown in sequence.

HGB-rank.Predicts: Next month's rank within the month
HGB-rank.Tuning: Number of trees chosen each year
HGB-rank.What it is: The same trees, predicting the rank target.

HGB-quintile.Predicts: Which quintile next month's return lands in
HGB-quintile.Tuning: Number of trees chosen each year
HGB-quintile.What it is: A classifier. It estimates the probability of each quintile, and stocks are sorted on their expected quintile.

realisticApproach: Long only, top 20, hold until rank > 60
